# Kindle reference book

Laid over `tests/fixtures/docx/reference` by `kindle_reference_book_is_complete`
(`crates/adoc-engine/tests/kindle_export.rs`): the Word reference book, with `[kindle]` settings
in place of `[docx]`'s, and an extra page in the manual's navigation holding Japanese and Greek
text, an id another page defines too, page aliases, a missing picture and a listing never
closed.
